newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United Arab Emirates raises salaries of federal government employees by 15 to 30 percent.
- Iraq plans to increase trade with Jordan and offers to provide Amman with 5,000 barrels of oil per day.
- Spain cancels Moroccan debts worth $50 million, converts them to investments.
- Qatar says Bahrain's accusation of spying is pretext to boycott the December 7 summit in Doha.
- Syria to inaugurate a telecommunications cable at a cost of $30 million.
- Riyadh development organisation discusses projects worth one billion riyals.
